purpose: Pin deterministic evidence-validity, phase-causality, calibration, continual-learning, and systems-efficiency scenarios before implementing the runner.
notes: A failed hard invariant cannot be averaged away by task reward.
Missing evidence is not the same label as zero error or maximal surprise.
Use deterministic seeds and retain raw per-cycle records.
Metric targets live in ../research/COGNITIVE_LOOP_EVIDENCE_BENCHMARK.md and are aspirational until measured.

external_drift_detectors.name: Fixed-threshold PE detector

external_drift_detectors.name: EWMA control-chart detector
external_drift_detectors.input_contract: Univariate valid PE or standardized residual stream; freeze smoothing and alarm thresholds using a separate calibration stream.

external_drift_detectors.name: ADWIN adaptive-window detector

drift_detector_comparison_protocol: Pin each detector implementation/version and hyperparameters; tune only on a disjoint calibration stream; use identical valid observations and no label access for the label-free track; never remap invalid/missing PE to zero or maximal surprise; report false alarms per 1,000 valid observations, missed-drift rate, detection-delay distribution, precision/recall by abrupt/gradual/recurring drift, invalid-sample coverage, throughput, and peak memory. Publish per-seed event traces. These detector candidates are planned, not yet implemented or measured.

drift_protocol.dataset_evaluation: Tune detector hyperparameters on all but one dataset; score once on the held-out dataset, repeating for every dataset. Freeze threshold choices before scoring held-out data.

detector_access_tracks.description: Consumes only finite prediction-error observations explicitly marked valid.
Consumes input features or representation statistics without target labels or outcome-derived error.
Consumes a pinned unsupervised auxiliary-loss stream, not target labels.
Consumes outcome-derived performance/errors when labels are observed; report label delay and availability.

drift_protocol.matching_rule: Process ground-truth events by ascending matching-window deadline (end_cycle + max_detection_delay_cycles). For each event, match the earliest unused valid-evidence alarm in [start_cycle, deadline]. One alarm matches at most one event. Unmatched alarms are false alarms; unmatched events are missed. Invalid/missing PE sentinels are not observations.
drift_protocol.tuning_policy: Use leave-one-dataset-out hyperparameter optimization and randomized Monte Carlo onset/parameters. Hold out datasets and seeds from threshold fitting; report both default and tuned configurations.
drift_protocol.claims: This adds an auditable comparison protocol and makes no claim that Symthaea beats any comparator. The referenced KDD 2026 paper reports SEED and STEPD as strong F1 baselines and ABCD as a compelling false-alarm trade-off.
drift_protocol.trace_contract: Each detector trace must pin detector_version and comparison_track, record label_delay_cycles even when zero, and mark evidence_valid on every alarm. An invalid-evidence alarm is never eligible to match a drift episode; it counts as a false alarm and must fail the hard gate.

paired_comparison_contract.resampling: paired hierarchical bootstrap: sample dataset clusters with replacement, then seeds within each selected dataset with each seed's complete paired scenario block intact; require the identical scenario panel across all datasets; give every sampled dataset equal final weight
paired_comparison_contract.claim_policy: A positive interval supports a positive paired effect only for the pinned metric, dataset set, evidence-access track, and configurations. It is not a universal SOTA claim. Report costs and all per-dataset outcomes.

sota_coverage_gate.meaning: Coverage eligibility only, not a performance result and not evidence of superiority. A scientific claim still requires matched protocols, actual comparator runs, per-dataset reporting, costs, and uncertainty.

kdd26_reference_protocol.stream_protocol: Prequential test-then-train; create a per-instance correctness/error stream from observed target and prediction; publish exact label timing and update order.
kdd26_reference_protocol.hyperparameter_protocol: Leave one dataset out; tune only on the remaining datasets; pin random-search budget and seeds; evaluate the held-out dataset once per fold.
kdd26_reference_protocol.important_limit: ABCD(X) and other feature-only methods cannot detect pure target-only changes without feature distribution change; do not use labels as hidden inputs.
kdd26_reference_protocol.status: reference protocol declared; adapters and datasets are not yet implemented/pinned
method_families: ABCD (error stream and ABCD(X) feature stream)

replay_identity_requirements: All arms consume the same pinned exogenous stream digest.
All arms emit the same contiguous cycle panel beginning at zero.
Pin arm version, repository head SHA, and configuration digest separately.
Oracle-timed policy uses ground-truth change timing only as a reference arm; it is not a deployable detector.
adaptation_counterfactual_protocol.unit_policy: Report task loss and adaptation resource cost as separate axes. Do not collapse them into a composite utility unless the cost conversion was preregistered.
adaptation_counterfactual_protocol.claim_policy: A shared stream digest and paired arm records do not prove hidden-state identity or implementation correctness. Oracle-timed is not a deployable detector; report all arm-level values.
